name: Gradientless Shading via Pixel Textures
definition: A shading technique that approximates the diffuse lighting gradient by computing forward differences of scalar material values using OpenGL blending and pixel textures, avoiding the need to store or copy the entire frame buffer for gradient calculation.
summary: Gradientless Shading via Pixel Textures approximates diffuse lighting by performing frame buffer arithmetic directly, avoiding explicit surface normal calculations or full frame buffer copies.
